published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Orc (follows its base build, warlock__demonology); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 1040.3 as Human on the same sim)

summary: Keeps its own Curse of the Elements up for the raid, with the raid's copy off. Under Forever the curse has its own slot, so the bane stays.
rotation: Pre-pull: Soul Link at -6s, Life Tap at -4.5s, Shadow Bolt at -2.5s (lands just after the pull)
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Curse of the Elements on duty for the raid, right after the opener and recast before it drops
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when down or under 1.5s left (more than 15s of fight left)
Immolate when down or under 1.5s left (more than 15s of fight left)
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
caveats: Takes Suppression 5/5 for its threat (standards 26), on the shared set at the 16% hit cap: 66.8 behind the one point build on the hit set at 180 s.
A bane and a curse use separate slots, so the duty curse costs only GCDs and mana.
Decimation's 3% is from the tooltip only.
Demon shares and Succubus melee are wowsims/forever's, read on pet sheets at levels 20 and 30, not 60.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era 1.0). At 2.0 Shadow Bolt builds lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit (forever-bugs #331). Worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warlock__demonology except -apl level60_demonology_duty_curse, then raid.debuffs.curseOfElements set to false. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed Imp, imbue Spellstone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
